author: RonDeSantis
text:
The C-43 reservoir is a key component of our Everglades restoration plan.  This provides the capacity to store water that is discharged by the Army Corps from Lake Okeechobee and then clean it before placing it in to the estuaries.  

Promise made and promise kept!
